title: Kshetra W021.5 — CTO Directive 152 Defect Ledger & Mandate Closure Register
directive: CTO Directive 152: Final Surgical Remediation and W021.5 Implementation Closure
governingAuthority: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.6 / Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance

mizoramDefect.description: 5 Mizoram statutory assembly seats (AC 31-35) with unrecorded voter counts preserved as NULL without zero-fabrication

defects.summary: Reconciled central authorization policy, plan selection, and execution dispatch into an explicit scope-bound model (STAGE_1 vs STAGE_2); distinguished conditional Stage 1 authorization from permanent prohibition of Stages 3 and 4
defects.directiveRequirement: Distinguish conditional authorization from permanent prohibition; bind authorization to explicit execution scope before requesting token grant; permit Stage 1 criterion CRIT-C02-02, Stage 1 tables, and write ops under STAGE_1 scope while prohibiting Stage 2; permit CRIT-D02-02 and candidacies under STAGE_2 scope while continuing to reject Stage 1; permanently prohibit Stages 3 and 4 under all scopes; enforce cross-scope denial with CROSS_SCOPE_GRANT_FORBIDDEN; require explicit scope in Mode B, failing closed if omitted or unsupported.
defects.remediationDetails: Defined STAGE1_TABLES, STAGE2_TABLES, PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED_TABLES, and PERMANENTLY_BLOCKED_CRITERIA in scripts/lib/stagingAuthorization.mjs. Updated verifyStagingWriteAuthorization() to validate params.executionScope and token scope claims, enforcing scope-bound criteria and table checks. Updated scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs to parse --scope=stage1/stage2 and fail closed with EXECUTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED or UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTION_SCOPE. Updated isStage1Authorized() to require authGrant.executionScope === 'STAGE_1'. Added positive-path and cross-scope denial tests.

defects.workstream: P0-B: Migration 069 Absent-Constraint Handling & Engine Integration
defects.summary: Replaced vulnerable SELECT ... INTO with deterministic existence detection (SELECT EXISTS) and full structural validity verification; proved behavior across 7 engine-level integration scenarios via embedded PostgreSQL
defects.directiveRequirement: Replace vulnerable SELECT ... INTO assignment with deterministic existence detection and full validity verification: on candidacies, references intended relation, local and referenced columns match, confdeltype = 'r', and convalidated = true; create missing constraints atomically; drop and recreate malformed, CASCADE, or unvalidated constraints; preserve valid constraints idempotently; execute against a real PostgreSQL engine across 7 explicit scenarios.
defects.remediationDetails: Hardened supabase/migrations/069_candidate_referential_integrity_reconciliation.sql using SELECT EXISTS(...) INTO v_exists followed by multi-attribute column-array validation (conkey, confkey, confdeltype = 'r', convalidated = true). Integrated @electric-sql/pglite true PostgreSQL engine into tests/migration-069-referential-integrity.test.mjs, proving all 7 mandated scenarios: 1) absent constraints created; 2) wrong relation/column replaced; 3) CASCADE replaced; 4) NOT VALID replaced; 5) valid constraints preserved; 6) idempotent reapplication; 7) full catalog verification.
regressionTests: tests/migration-069-referential-integrity.test.mjs (15/15 PASS: 8 static catalog checks + 7 real PostgreSQL engine integration tests)

defects.summary: Hardened target-state retrieval to strictly fail closed on missing/malformed Content-Range, wildcard totals, range/offset mismatches, count changes between pages, and duplicate/overlapping row IDs
defects.directiveRequirement: Require syntactically valid Content-Range header on every page (TARGET_STATE_MISSING_CONTENT_RANGE, TARGET_STATE_MALFORMED_CONTENT_RANGE); reject wildcard totals with TARGET_STATE_WILDCARD_TOTAL_FORBIDDEN; handle empty table */0 with empty body, rejecting non-empty with TARGET_STATE_INVALID_EMPTY_RESPONSE; verify range start equals offset and range end equals offset + rows - 1 (TARGET_STATE_PAGINATION_RANGE_INVALID); verify total count consistency across pages (TARGET_STATE_PAGINATION_TOTAL_CHANGED); detect duplicate/overlapping row IDs (TARGET_STATE_PAGINATION_OVERLAPPING_ROWS); confirm all 8 tables retrieved (TARGET_STATE_INCOMPLETE_TABLE_SET).
defects.remediationDetails: Implemented complete fail-closed validation in fetchTargetDatabaseState() in scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs. Exported function and updated tests/helpers/stagingStageTestAdapters.mjs. Added comprehensive test coverage in tests/stage1-target-state-retrieval-security.test.mjs covering all 8 pagination failure modes.

defects.workstream: P1: Natural Keys, Election View Contract, and Final Mandate Closure
defects.summary: Preserved natural key conflict targets in child tables and 16-column TEXT election view contract; reconciled execution registers, execution state, and unified verifier for mandate closure
defects.directiveRequirement: Preserve natural key conflict targets in organization child tables; retain vw_legacy_election_results 16-column contract with TEXT column types and non-drop-in status; recompute Migration 069 SHA-256 and update schema contract specification; update execution register, execution state, and decision log (DEC-152); deliver final closure report with definitive disposition.
defects.remediationDetails: Retained verified natural-key conflict targets in scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs and reports/w021_5_schema_contract_specification.json. Maintained vw_legacy_election_results contract with TEXT types in tests/historical-election-results-23-states.test.mjs (all 23 states PASS). Recomputed Migration 069 SHA-256 (cebe61606b0c93af6e4859f6e7fb16b45215dd3dab7edff20d2229368343a4be) in schema contract specification. Logged DEC-152 and updated EXECUTION_STATE.md and reports/w021_5_database_execution_register.json.
